title: botrychium multifidum var. oneidense
intro: Botrychium multifidum var. oneidense, commonly known as Oneida rattlesnake fern, is a rare and endangered variety of the fern species Botrychium multifidum. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include treating conditions such as fever, rheumatism, and skin irritations. The therapeutic actions of Oneida rattlesnake fern are attributed to its anti-inflammatory and antiseptic properties, which help to soothe and calm the body. The bioactive constituents of this plant include glycosides, terpenoids, and other compounds that contribute to its medicinal properties, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
